comments.body:
Now also sold in Viana do Castelo with sufficient development, and 8.5 million ducat investments. (Which actually means this good will be accessible to Portuguese players only, then.)

VdC's development as of this post is 55k, but that's apparently not high enough. Still, it'll be something for Portuguese players to enjoy in the near future.
